title: A recorded clear is classed from the cgroup it stored
intention: cairn/devices/trouble/trouble.py _handle_clears serves, for a clear whose stored hand class is 'unknown' and whose hand carries a cgroup, the class the artifact door's classify() gives that cgroup now; any other stored class is served as stored.
why: Measured 2026-10-12: Akien's nine who-writes-what clears from his Konsole tab are recorded in each trouble's cleared_by with by=akien, the kernel-measured cgroup .../app-org.kde.konsole-78471.scope/tab(3360690).scope, and class 'unknown' (the leaf-only classifier that b63f5bbbef89 fixes). cairn/devices/trouble/trouble.py _handle_clears (line ~189) serves hand_class from the STORED class, so the counting block (cairn/machines/counting_block/block.py:176, which learns a row only from an akien hand) never learns those rows even after b63f lands. Akien ruled 2026-10-12: 'no we just say it's allowed damn it. this was all supposed to be allowed thru PROVED'; cc closed the nine on his ruling, which closes but does not teach, so the troubles recur.
traces_to: Law 3 (the kernel measurement outranks a label derived by an older classifier) and Law 1 (Akien's settled clears are not re-asked of him).
how: cairn/devices/trouble/trouble.py _handle_clears only: when hand.get('class') folds to 'unknown' (or is absent) and hand.get('cgroup') is a string, hand_class = fold(door.classify(cgroup)['class']) via the artifact tool's public interface (cairn.tools.artifact.artifact, already imported at trouble.py:481); otherwise unchanged. The stored record is never rewritten (a record of truth); only the served row is derived. A stored 'cc' or 'gate' is never re-classed, so nothing is upgraded to akien. Depends on b63f5bbbef89 (the classifier that reads a tab scope).
falsifier: cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_a_recorded_clear_is_classed_from_its_cgroup.py under PROVES {'4f8d11706516': {'1','2','3'}}: (1) a trouble whose cleared_by holds {by: akien, hand: {class: unknown, cgroup: '/user.slice/user-1000.slice/user@1000.service/app.slice/app-org.kde.konsole-78471.scope/tab(3360690).scope'}} serves hand_class akien from _handle_clears; (2) a stored class cc with an app-*.scope cgroup is served cc, and an unknown with no cgroup is served unknown; (3) the trouble file's bytes are unchanged after the read. Hollow: today's stored-class read reds 1. In the world: after PROVED, block.py's recompiled table holds a row for each of the nine who-writes-what pairs.

decisions.text: Derive at read, never rewrite the stored hand: cleared_by is a record of truth (Law 7). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
Only 'unknown' is re-classed; cc and gate stand as stored, so the derivation can never manufacture an akien hand from a cc clear. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
